selection_policy.activation: A context-fitting selected v6 bundle requires evidence for its own relations and components; retrieval alone creates no duty, and listed existing profile IDs gain no automatic hard authority.
selection_policy.intent_precedence: Preserve requester-defined setting, action, people, weather, cleanliness, composition and other locked dimensions.
selection_policy.source_scope: Sources support activity coverage and visual relation/state representations; scenario examples and visual gates are authorial, untested design proposals.

role_graph: person adjusts shoe at doorway
personal bag or coat is within departure reach
visible_requirements: hand and shoe form a plausible adjustment contact
doorway or entrance boundary is legible
the departure item has a stable location near the person
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: At the apartment doorway, a person finishes adjusting one shoe while the bag they are taking rests within reach.

role_graph: person prepares ingredient on work surface
utensil acts on ingredient
changed ingredient remains at the same station
visible_requirements: working hand, utensil and ingredient share one reachable work area
partly prepared and unprepared material can be distinguished
work surface supports the active tools
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: In a usable home kitchen, one hand moves cut vegetables from the board toward a bowl while the remaining uncut pieces stay beside it.

role_graph: person sorts garment between two laundry groups
machine or basket marks the next step
visible_requirements: the hand holds a garment between distinct groups
groups occupy supported surfaces or baskets
machine or destination basket is spatially reachable
reject_substitutes: all clothes already inside a closed machine
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: At a laundry station, a person moves one garment from the unsorted basket toward a second sorted group.

role_graph: person returns an item to a usable place
one work area is now clear
one small task remains in progress
visible_requirements: the hand and item form a coherent placement action
a cleared surface and an active small area coexist
walking space remains passable without imposed dirt
reject_substitutes: blank showroom with no current task
poverty or dirt as a realism shortcut
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: A person puts the last folded cloth away in a clean, actively used room; the nearby work surface is cleared and the path remains open.

role_graph: customer waits facing service point
uncollected drink remains on service side
route for handoff is open
visible_requirements: pickup counter or handoff position is visible
waiting person is oriented to that position
the drink has not already become the person's consumed cup
reject_substitutes: person drinking a full cup while described as waiting
generic cafe background without service geometry
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: At a small cafe pickup counter, a customer waits beside an open handoff space while a prepared cup remains behind the counter.

role_graph: shopper compares first item with second item
both items belong to the same choice context
visible_requirements: two plausible alternatives are simultaneously visible
hand or attention links the shopper to both
shelf, basket or stall supports the choice setting
optional_context: small price tags without required readability
reject_substitutes: one item held without an alternative
readable price arithmetic demanded at thumbnail size
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: At a market shelf, a shopper holds one item near a second comparable choice and looks between them before placing either in the basket.

role_graph: customer brings payment token to terminal
counter supports purchased item
service or pickup side is distinct
visible_requirements: payment tool approaches a reachable terminal or cashier position
item and counter share a supported checkout area
customer and service sides are distinguishable
reject_substitutes: brand or financial data required to read
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: At a checkout counter, a customer brings a card toward the payment terminal while the item rests on the counter within the same transaction.

role_graph: passenger faces open bus doorway
stop or curb connects to boarding path
bag remains with passenger
visible_requirements: bus doorway and passenger are in the same navigable space
the person is moving or poised toward the doorway
curb or platform height permits the step
reject_substitutes: person waiting for a late bus without a bus present
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: A passenger adjusts a bag strap as an open bus doorway becomes reachable from the stop curb.

role_graph: passenger crosses carriage door
platform is destination
other passenger flow stays distinct
visible_requirements: open train door separates carriage from platform
the exiting person's body direction crosses the threshold
supporting floor levels and route are plausible
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: A passenger steps across an open train doorway onto the platform while waiting riders leave a clear path.

role_graph: person folds wet umbrella
wet outdoor route remains beyond doorway
water remains on umbrella not randomly elsewhere
visible_requirements: inside-outside threshold is identifiable
hand and umbrella show a plausible folding state
wetness is localized to the umbrella and weather-exposed area
reject_substitutes: rain in a scene requested as dry
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: Just inside the doorway, a person folds a rain-wet umbrella; the wet pavement stays visible outside and a floor mat receives the drips.

role_graph: worker carries drink from shared area
desk is destination
hands have feasible load
visible_requirements: source passage and destination desk are spatially connected
held object is supported by a visible hand
walking route to desk remains open
reject_substitutes: full cup floating above inaccessible hand
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: A worker carries one cup back along the office passage toward a visible desk, with the route between pantry and workstation unobstructed.

role_graph: reader lifts page
book rests on support
other hand or posture stabilizes reading position
visible_requirements: one page visibly separates from the open book
fingers contact a reachable page edge
book is supported on lap or table
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: At a library table, the reader lifts a single page by its edge while the book stays supported beside a notebook.

role_graph: visitor waits in seating zone
reception or service direction remains legible
other visitors, if present, have separate space
visible_requirements: waiting seats and reception/service direction belong to one room
the visitor has a plausible waiting position
no treatment is shown unless explicitly requested
optional_context: appointment card without readable private details
reject_substitutes: treatment equipment added as waiting proof
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: A visitor waits in a clean clinic seating area with the reception route visible beyond the chairs.

role_graph: person removes cloth from open machine
basket receives cloth
hand path joins machine and basket
visible_requirements: machine door is open and accessible
cloth, hand and basket follow one reachable transfer path
basket sits stably near the machine
reject_substitutes: closed machine with separate full basket
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: At a laundromat, a person draws a piece of cloth from the open washer toward a stable basket just below the door.

role_graph: visitor writes on form
writing surface supports form
submission counter is distinct destination
visible_requirements: pen contacts a form on a stable writing surface
visitor is positioned at a form station
submission point or service route is legible without readable text
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: At a public-service writing counter, a visitor fills in a form on the supported desk before moving toward the submission window.

role_graph: walker pauses beside route
bench or low wall supports rest
carried item stays with walker
visible_requirements: path and rest point are connected
body weight or hand has plausible support
water bottle or bag has a stable held or resting position if selected
reject_substitutes: bench located apart from the path
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: A walker pauses on a bench beside the park path, one hand resting near the carried water bottle while the route continues behind.

role_graph: person A presents one phone to person B
person B looks to the same screen
person B gives a small visible response
visible_requirements: one screen lies between two reachable participants
both attention directions converge on that screen
one participant's gesture or expression responds to the shared content
reject_substitutes: each person looks at a separate phone
screen faces camera but not recipient
claim about exact content without visible evidence
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: Two friends look toward the same phone as one tilts it toward the other and the listener begins to smile.

role_graph: worker clears used counter
remaining tray or chair marks work in progress
exit route remains usable
visible_requirements: worker is actively moving or wiping an item
some service fixtures are being put away while others remain in place
the shop reads as maintained and occupied
reject_substitutes: all lights off while active work needs visibility
piled trash as the only closing cue
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: After service, a shop worker wipes one section of the counter while a few trays remain to be put away.

role_graph: person opens parcel
box flaps show changed state
content remains connected to packaging
visible_requirements: hand contacts opened flap or content
box is supported on floor or table
content and packaging occupy the same work area
optional_context: delivery label without readable private data
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: At a home table, a person lifts one open parcel flap while the partly revealed contents and packing paper remain beside the box.

role_graph: foreground actor performs focal task
background person performs a different task
their paths or work areas remain distinct
visible_requirements: both people's tasks are individually identifiable at the chosen scale
background activity has a separate target or route
background person does not block the requested focal action
optional_context: another customer in a different phase
reject_substitutes: second person copied into a solo/private request
candidate_bundles.prompt_seed_en: The focal person finishes a purchase while, farther back, another customer independently browses a shelf along a separate aisle.
